> the session history, or any transcript."},{"id":"p4s1","text":"🌐 中文：README.zh.md ｜ **English**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Why"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"You paste an API key or a token into the chat. Without protection it goes straight

- The"},{"id":"p40s2","text":" value is **SENSITIVE**: the tool description instructs the model never to
